mapper.select: SELECT CASE bo.reward_type WHEN 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN COALESCE(ubu.reward_original_value, 0) ELSE ubu.reward_amount_krw END) AS SIGNED) AS amount FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, ubu.confirmed_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, ubu.confirmed_at) < #{toUtc} GROUP BY bo.reward_type ORDER BY amount DESC, benefit_type ASC

SELECT mc.category_code, mc.category_name, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN COALESCE(ubu.reward_original_value, 0) ELSE ubu.reward_amount_krw END) AS SIGNED) AS benefit_amount FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN merchants merchant ON merchant.merchant_id = approval.merchant_id INNER JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.merchant_category_id = merchant.merchant_category_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) < #{toUtc} GROUP BY mc.merchant_category_id, mc.category_code, mc.category_name ORDER BY benefit_amount DESC, mc.category_code ASC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH eligible_limit_rows AS ( SELECT uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(policy.shared_group_key, policy.limit_policy_id) AS limit_group_key, rule.rule_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(rule.rule_name, ''), offer.offer_name) AS title, CASE offer.reward_type WHEN 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, CASE WHEN policy.limit_type = 'reward_amount' AND policy.limit_unit IN ('KRW', 'point') THEN tier.limit_value WHEN policy.limit_type = 'usage_count' AND policy.limit_unit = 'count' AND offer.value_type = 'fixed_amount' AND offer.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback') AND rule.reward_unit = 'KRW' THEN tier.limit_value * rule.reward_value ELSE 0 END AS limit_amount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards card ON card.card_id = uc.card_id INNER JOIN card_content_versions content ON content.card_id = card.card_id INNER JOIN card_benefits benefit ON benefit.content_version_id = content.content_version_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers offer ON offer.benefit_id = benefit.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_rules rule ON rule.offer_id = offer.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies policy ON policy.offer_id = offer.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_tiers tier ON tier.limit_policy_id = policy.limit_policy_id LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots previous_performance ON previous_performance.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND previous_performance.performance_month = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots current_performance ON current_performance.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND current_performance.performance_month = #{yearMonth} WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = content.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > content.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = content.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > content.content_version_id)) ) AND offer.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND rule.rule_effect = 'grant' AND (rule.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR rule.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND (rule.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR rule.current_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(current_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND (rule.valid_from IS NULL OR rule.valid_from <= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (rule.valid_to IS NULL OR rule.valid_to >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND policy.limit_period = 'monthly' AND (policy.valid_from IS NULL OR policy.valid_from <= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (policy.valid_to IS NULL OR policy.valid_to >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (policy.applicable_months_json IS NULL OR JSON_CONTAINS( policy.applicable_months_json, CAST(CAST(SUBSTRING(#{yearMonth}, 6, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS JSON), '$')) AND (tier.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR tier.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND (tier.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR tier.current_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(current_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_limit_tiers higher_tier WHERE higher_tier.limit_policy_id = tier.limit_policy_id AND (higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND (higher_tier.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR higher_tier.current_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(current_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND ( COALESCE(higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) > COALESCE(tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) OR (COALESCE(higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) = COALESCE(tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) AND COALESCE(higher_tier.current_spend_min_krw, 0) > COALESCE(tier.current_spend_min_krw, 0)) OR (COALESCE(higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) = COALESCE(tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) AND COALESCE(higher_tier.current_spend_min_krw, 0) = COALESCE(tier.current_spend_min_krw, 0) AND higher_tier.position > tier.position) ) ) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements requirement WHERE requirement.offer_id = offer.offer_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements requirement INNER JOIN user_card_option_selections selection ON selection.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND selection.option_group_id = requirement.option_group_id AND selection.option_choice_id = requirement.option_choice_id WHERE requirement.offer_id = offer.offer_id ) ) ), eligible_limit_rules AS ( SELECT user_card_id, limit_group_key, rule_id AS benefit_rule_id, title, benefit_type, MAX(limit_amount) AS limit_amount FROM eligible_limit_rows WHERE limit_amount > 0 GROUP BY user_card_id, limit_group_key, rule_id, title, benefit_type ), monthly_usage_rows AS ( SELECT outcome.user_card_id, outcome.rule_id, COALESCE(policy.shared_group_key, policy.limit_policy_id) AS limit_group_key, outcome.applied_reward_value AS used_amount FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes outcome INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies policy ON policy.limit_policy_id = outcome.limit_policy_id WHERE outcome.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND outcome.outcome_status IN ('applied', 'partially_applied') AND LOWER(outcome.reward_unit) IN ('krw', 'point') AND outcome.usage_date >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01') AND outcome.usage_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) UNION ALL SELECT benefit_usage.user_card_id, benefit_usage.rule_id, COALESCE(policy.shared_group_key, policy.limit_policy_id) AS limit_group_key, CASE WHEN benefit_usage.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN COALESCE(benefit_usage.reward_original_value, 0) ELSE benefit_usage.reward_amount_krw END AS used_amount FROM user_benefit_usages benefit_usage INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies policy ON policy.limit_policy_id = benefit_usage.limit_policy_id WHERE benefit_usage.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND benefit_usage.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND benefit_usage.usage_date >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01') AND benefit_usage.usage_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes outcome WHERE outcome.approval_id = benefit_usage.approval_id AND outcome.rule_id = benefit_usage.rule_id ) ), monthly_usage_by_rule AS ( SELECT user_card_id, rule_id AS benefit_rule_id, SUM(used_amount) AS used_amount FROM monthly_usage_rows GROUP BY user_card_id, rule_id ) SELECT limits.benefit_rule_id, limits.title, limits.benefit_type, CAST(LEAST(limits.limit_amount, COALESCE(usage_data.used_amount, 0)) AS SIGNED) AS used_amount, CAST(limits.limit_amount AS SIGNED) AS limit_amount FROM eligible_limit_rules limits LEFT JOIN monthly_usage_by_rule usage_data ON usage_data.user_card_id = limits.user_card_id AND usage_data.benefit_rule_id = limits.benefit_rule_id ORDER BY GREATEST(limits.limit_amount - COALESCE(usage_data.used_amount, 0), 0) DESC, limits.title ASC

SELECT uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) AS card_name, NULLIF(cv.image_url, '') AS card_image_url, CAST(COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) AS SIGNED) AS current_performance_amount,
CAST(COALESCE( (SELECT next_tier.minimum_spend_krw FROM card_performance_tiers next_tier WHERE next_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND next_tier.minimum_spend_krw > COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) ORDER BY next_tier.minimum_spend_krw ASC LIMIT 1), (SELECT MAX(last_tier.minimum_spend_krw) FROM card_performance_tiers last_tier WHERE last_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id), cv.representative_spend, 0) AS SIGNED) AS current_tier_target_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT current_tier.tier_number FROM card_performance_tiers current_tier WHERE current_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND current_tier.minimum_spend_krw <= COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) AND (current_tier.maximum_spend_krw IS NULL OR COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) <= current_tier.maximum_spend_krw) ORDER BY current_tier.tier_number DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS current_tier, ( SELECT next_tier.tier_number FROM card_performance_tiers next_tier WHERE next_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND next_tier.minimum_spend_krw > COALESCE(snapshot.current_spend_amount, 0) ORDER BY next_tier.minimum_spend_krw ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS next_tier, uc.display_order FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots snapshot ON snapshot.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND snapshot.performance_month = #{yearMonth}
mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id, tier.tier_number AS tier, CAST(tier.minimum_spend_krw AS SIGNED) AS target_amount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id INNER JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id INNER JOIN card_performance_tiers tier ON tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) ORDER BY uc.display_order ASC, uc.user_card_id ASC, tier.tier_number ASC
